messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU_POOL_DEPLETION detected for pool us-west3-a100-pool (available GPUs dropped to 18%): paging on-call

sarah: oncall here, seeing a spike in inference queue latency, >95th p95. Is customer impact confirmed?

max: seeing 429s / throttles from the frontend -> inference gateway. Autoscaler logs show scale-up requests failing due to quota in us-west3. Investigating now.

jess: FYI prod traffic spike from churned batch jobs at 04:17, likely causing sustained demand. Some customers reported slow responses.

leo: spun up a temporary fallback route to quantized-model-128 to reduce per-token GPU time. Routing rule applied: 10% traffic -> fallback.

infra-bot: ACTION: created emergency instance request ticket cloud-req-8721 for A100 reservation in us-west3, ETA 35m.

max: quick note: autoscaler minNodes was 1 (incorrect for this pool) after last week's tweaks; the aggressive scale-down cut capacity overnight. Opening a fix PR now to set minNodes=3 and bump scale-up cooldown.

sarah: good catch. @max please also confirm preemptible VS on-demand mix — preemptibles are getting reclaimed.

max: confirmed — ~40% of the pool is preemptible and got preempted during the churn. Asking infra for immediate on-demand replacements.

tina: coordinating with infra to convert 8 nodes to on-demand (A100) in us-west3. If infra can speed that to <30m we probably avoid customer-facing errors.

oliver-pm: customers flagged: 3 enterprise tenants on higher SLA saw degraded RTT. We may need to notify them if ETA slips.

jess: putting together a short message for SRE -> CS in #customer-impact so they can triage outreach.

sarah: bridge up? I prefer a quick quick-bridge for triage.

leo: creating bridge: https://meet.redwood/bridge/1905002468 (bridge pinned).

incident-bot: BRIDGE: open (1905002468). Participants: sarah, max, jess, leo, tina, infra-team.

--- 20 minutes later ---

infra-bot: UPDATE: 6 on-demand A100s provisioned, 2 remain pending. Autoscaler now has headroom.

max: scaling behavior normalized. p95 latency back down to baseline after routing change and new nodes. Monitoring shows no new 429s in last 5m.

sarah: returning to on-call watch. We'll keep the fallback routing for 10m then slowly roll back.

leo: rollback plan: remove fallback from 10% -> 0 over next 10 minutes if stable.

jess: customer-impact slack note sent to CS with list of impacted tenants + suggested messaging.

oliver-pm: schedule a post-incident review (PIR) and remediation follow-up. Available window tomorrow 11:00-12:00 PT. Need SRE, Infra, Prod, CS.

sarah: ack. I'll capture immediate action items in this thread.

--- Next day, PIR planning thread continues ---

max: PIR scheduled: 1905086400 (tomorrow) 11:00 PT. Agenda: root cause, immediate mitigations, remediation owner assignments, runbook updates, alert tuning.

tina: preliminary notes for PIR: 1) minNodes misconfiguration (1 instead of 3) 2) high preemptible usage during peak 3) autoscaler cooldown too short 4) no emergency on-demand playbook.

leo: sharing graphs in the PIR doc: link https://docs.redwood/pir/gpu-depletion-1905002468 (detailed token/time-series).

sarah: action items to assign before PIR to reduce noise: a) collect autoscaler logs and timeline (owner: max) b) infra provisioning timeline + quota request artifacts (owner: tina) c) determine impacted customer list and messages (owner: jess) d) draft runbook edits for emergency on-demand conversion (owner: max + infra)

max: taking (a) and (d). Will open a PR in infra/runbooks with proposed snippet.

tina: taking (b). Will attach cloud ticket numbers and time-to-provision metrics.

jess: taking (c) and will coordinate with CS for outreach drafts.

sarah: add (e) metric tuning: raise capacity-remaining alert threshold from 20% -> 30% and add sustained-depletion alert (owner: leo).

leo: taking (e). I'll also add a dashboard tile for preemptible ratio by pool.

--- After PIR (notes and assigned remediation items) ---

max: PIR summary: root cause = combination of autoscaler minNodes misconfig + high preemptible churn + quota delay for on-demand instance provisioning. Immediate fixes applied: set minNodes=3, increased scale-up cooldown to 180s, enabled temporary routing fallback.

tina: infra follow-ups: 1) expedite quota baseline for critical pools in us-west3 (owner: tina) 2) add a CLI runbook to convert N preemptible -> on-demand instances (owner: infra-team) 3) build a pre-warm buffer for peak hours (owner: infra-program).

jess: customer ops follow-ups: 1) notify affected enterprise tenants with timeline and remediation summary (owner: CS) 2) propose credits if SLA hit confirmed (owner: CS/finance)

sarah: SRE follow-ups: 1) add an automated canary that simulates short burst load to test autoscaler policy every midnight (owner: max) 2) add a guard in deploy pipeline that rejects changing pool minNodes < 2 without explicit approval (owner: platform-team).

oliver-pm: product follow-ups: 1) evaluate if we should expose per-tenant capacity reservations (owner: product) 2) prioritize low-effort optimizations like default fallback routing for heavy customers (owner: product-eng).

--- Action item tracking in thread (due dates added) ---

max: ACTION: PR to infra/runbooks: emergency-on-demand-conversion.md (due 1905090000)

tina: ACTION: quota baseline ticket + followup with cloud ops (ticket: cloud-req-8721) (due 1905093600)

leo: ACTION: update alert thresholds + add preemptible ratio dashboard (due 1905097200)

jess: ACTION: customer notification drafts + CS sync (due 1905097200)

sarah: ACTION: add pipeline guard to reject minNodes < 2 (opened issue platform-457, due 1905100800)

oliver-pm: ACTION: decide on per-tenant reservation roadmap item (milestone doc link) (due 1905120000)

--- Follow-ups over the next week (check-ins) ---

max: PR opened: infra/runbooks#342 (link) with conversion steps, test checklist, and rollback. Marking as in-review.

tina: cloud-req-8721 updated: quota approved for +12 A100 in us-west3. Provisioning window confirmed.

leo: alerts updated: capacity-remaining now fires at 30% (warning) and 20% (critical), sustained-depletion alert added (5m sustained <25%). Dashboard tile live.

jess: CS sent customer notices; two enterprise customers requested postmortem copies and timeline — drafting now.

sarah: verifying deploy pipeline guard merged?

max: platform-457 PR merged, pipeline now blocks pushes that set minNodes < 2 without approval.

oliver-pm: marking PIR action items as in-progress in tracker. Will re-run a short tabletop in two weeks to validate.

--- Closure note after remediation work complete ---

tina: confirmed: baseline on-demand headroom in us-west3 increased, quota +12 A100 available, and a pre-warm job scheduled during predicted peaks.

max: autoscaler config patched, nightly canary added. Runbook PR merged and linked in runbooks index.

leo: alerting and dashboards verified; added a weekly report to SRE digest for pool-preemptible ratios.

jess: customers notified, two requested credits; finance looped.

sarah: closing incident thread: root cause & remediations captured; follow-up: 2-week tabletop to validate playbooks on 1906210000. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 1905002468 - GPU pool depletion mitigated. Postmortem: scheduled and action items tracked.
